title: Upping My P(doom) — illustrated anime music video on AI history
summary: A 2.5-minute sung music video in risograph/anime illustration style: an orange flower-haired idol sings through AI history (Sparks of AGI, loss curves, ChatGPT, shoggoths, scaling, acceleration, P(doom)) with her flower-headed backup crew. Huge pink display words punch in on the lyrics, paper-tag captions sit bottom-left, and a 'LIVE' date stamp in the top-right ticks forward from 2019 to 2026. Dense, witty, insider-joke energy with a printed-paper texture.
fit_reason: Brilliant craft but anime characters, AI-doom lyrics and a music-video format are far from a plain, founder-led B2B portal brand; only the paper-tag captions and date-stamp devices transfer.

palette.mood: warm risograph print: cream paper, navy ink, hot pink, orange; sunburst backgrounds in pink or mustard; teal and navy-blue scenes later

typography.display: condensed heavy grotesk in hot pink with halftone texture (I SEE SPARKS OF AGI, LOSS, FOOM, ACCELERATING); condensed slab/poster type for SHOW, BLUES; handwritten italic script for asides ('that's no', 'a gentle singularity')
typography.case: upper for display, sentence case for captions
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: giant lyric words that fill half the frame next to the character, small caption tags
typography.notes: Paper scraps carry citations (arXiv abstract cards, 'FERMAT'S LAST THEOREM' note, 'VON NEUMANN ARCHITECTURE 1945-2026'). Top-right always has a '● LIVE 2019.02.17' date-stamp tag; some scenes add a percentage tag top-left (4.2% → 99.9%) that climbs through the song.

text_animation: lyric words appear word-by-word in sync with the singing (I SEE / SPARKS / OF, then AGI punches in big)
paper tags slide in at a slight tilt and settle
counter tags tick up (P(doom) %, time-horizon numbers)
captions: phrase — small off-white paper tag bottom-left with sans text, the key word underlined in the accent colour ('There was a sudden drop in your training loss.'); karaoke-style display words separately
motion: limited-animation character loops (2-3 drawings per move, on twos)
camera push-ins on the character's face
panels splitting into comic-strip grids (34.0 s)
particles dissolving a portrait into dots (46 s)
line-chart drawing on with a mascot riding the line
graphic_elements: halftone dots and paper grain on everything
ui_treatment: none; data is shown as hand-drawn charts and paper notes

sound.music: J-pop / synth-pop song with female vocal, ~-16 LUFS
sound.sync: yes: cuts and word punches land on sung words

signature_moves: risograph cream-paper + navy + hot-pink look with halftone
giant pink lyric words beside the character
paper-tag subtitle bottom-left with underlined keyword
'LIVE' date stamp that advances through the video as a timeline

best_segments.what: 'I SEE SPARKS OF AGI' builds word by word beside the singer, then an arXiv paper card slides in bottom-right.

recreate.how: Needs illustrated character art (commissioned or AI image + manual cleanup) animated on twos; type, tags and date stamp are easy in HTML+GSAP over the art. Add halftone + grain overlay in post.
recreate.prompt: Risograph-style illustrated music video: cream paper #dad3c3, navy ink #47547d, hot pink #dc5a8c and orange #e87d50 with halftone texture. A character sings beside giant condensed pink lyric words that appear word by word; small paper-tag subtitles bottom-left with the key word underlined; a 'LIVE' date stamp top-right that advances each scene.
